title: Table Mountain National Park – SANParks
facts: Table Mountain National Park extends from Signal Hill and Table Mountain to Cape Point and encompasses mountain and coastal landscapes.
Official park navigation identifies Table Mountain, Boulders, Cape Point and Signal Hill as attractions.
confidence: official-source; editorial review limited to listed stable facts
